name: Holt's Helpful Hands Handyman Service

resenas.texto: I have used handyman services in the past, Holts is by far the best, most knowledgeable, efficient, clean and courteous ever. I called and immediately got a wonderful customer service response n Nathaniel contacted me the same day.
Excellent experience! Prompt, courteous, professional, and I will definitely recommend to my friends. I hired Nathaniel to place ceiling lights in my kitchen.

Nathaniel was highly recommended by my neighbor to do a few odd jobs (caulking, changing sink drain etc). He was very professional, prompt, and very detail-oriented. He was also very respectful and meticulous, making sure he left everything clean. Highly recommend his services.
I called Nathan and he called back right away. He is very courteous and he came over and was very professional and did a wonderful job putting together my patio set.

Nathanial was amazing to work with! He completely remodeled my entire office and added electrical outlets throughout the home. The job was done quickly and professionally. I strongly recommend Holts helpful hands!
